available_field_energy_vs_registered_exc.interpretation_boundary: This proxy shows strong cancellation between longitudinal electric-energy change and the registered cumulative exchange. It is not the requested independent field-transfer versus matter-transfer conditioning measure and cannot establish the causal mechanism of the residual failure.

requested_exact_sector_transfer_kappa.reason: The preserved output does not separate longitudinal matter-sector and field-sector transfer series. No exact field-versus-matter cancellation kappa is assigned.
